candidates.explanation: The stored path is built as `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`, so it leaves out the `files` segment. The download route is `GET /{apiPrefix}/v1/files/:path` (controller path 'files', version '1'), so the returned link doesn't match any route and gives 404, even though the file is on disk.

fix.description: Include the `files` segment in the path: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`.
